text: dsh-chat-width 是面向 DSH Web 的界面样式插件，通过客户端 bundle 注入 CSS，调整对话主内容列的最大宽度。侧栏展开时，内容列可填满中间区域；侧栏收起后，宽度按视口比例自适应，并设有最小值和上限。它也让历史用户消息气泡和输入框下方的统计行跟随内容列宽度。用户可在浏览器本地存储中设置固定宽度，或使用默认规则。适合希望在大屏或宽窗口中利用更多横向空间的 DSH Web 用户；需要 DSH Web profile 客户端插件系统，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-chat-width widens the DSH Web chat column with client CSS. Width adapts as side panels collapse; message bubbles and composer statistics follow it. Users may set a fixed width locally. Requires the DSH Web client plugin system; no key or external service.
屏幕很宽但聊天内容还是窄窄一列，能让它铺开些吗？
想让对话区宽度跟着浏览器窗口大小自动调整。
Can I make the chat column wider when I collapse the side panels?
dsh-chat-width 的功能「自适应对话宽度」：根据视口宽度计算内容列上限，并限制在最小宽度与最大上限之间；侧栏展开时内容不超过中间列。默认规则无需手动适配分辨率。
dsh-chat-width 的功能「跟随内容列的消息与统计区域」：注入的样式让历史用户消息气泡和输入框下方的统计行使用对话内容列宽度，避免它们仍受各自较窄的固定宽度限制。

dsh-chat-width README · dsh-chat-width：> 简体中文: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

A small DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin that makes the chat content column adapt to the screen resolution — when both side panels are collapsed, the middle area no longer stays stuck at the fixed 748px.

dsh-chat-width README · What it does：The DSH chat content column is hard-coded to 748px (`--dsh-chat-content-width: 748px`), so the middle area stays narrow with large empty margins even after both side panels are collapsed. This plugin injects CSS that overrides the width to `min(100%, adaptive cap)`:

dsh-chat-width README · Install：Method 1 — recommended, one command (restart `dsh web` afterwards):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/AnakinCao/dsh-chat-width.git
```

Method 2 — no restart (manual mount): append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-chat-width
      name: 'dsh-chat-width'
```

and place the repository content under `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-chat-width/` (or `pnpm add`), then refresh the page once.

> Pick ONE method — never mount twice.

dsh-chat-width README · Adaptive rule (default)：```
max width = min(100%, clamp(900px, 72vw, 2560px))
```

| Viewport | Content width |
| --- | --- |
| 1366×768 | ≈983px |
| 1920×1080 | ≈1382px |
| 2560×1440 | ≈1843px |
| 3840×2160 | 2560px (cap) |

Tracks window size changes live — no refresh needed.

dsh-chat-width README · Tuning：Edit the three constants at the top of `lib/client.js` — changes hot-apply via DSH client HMR (~0.5s), no restart / no refresh:

- `ADAPTIVE_RATIO` (default `0.72`) — fraction of the viewport width
- `MIN_WIDTH` (default `"900px"`) — lower bound
- `MAX_CAP` (default `"2560px"`) — upper bound (raise it for 4K+)

Or force a fixed width from the browser console (takes effect after refresh):

dsh-chat-width README · Tuning：```js
localStorage.setItem('dsh-chat-width.max', '1920px')  // fixed 1920px
localStorage.removeItem('dsh-chat-width.max')          // back to adaptive
```

A console log line prints the active viewport and width rule on page load.

dsh-chat-width README · Uninstall：- Installed via method 1: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chat-width`, then restart `dsh web`;
- Installed via method 2: remove the insert entry from the profile `cordis.patch.yml` and delete `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-chat-width/`, then refresh the page.

dsh-chat-width README · Compatibility：- Requires the DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 web profile client plugin system (`dsh web`, `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle format).
- Selectors target the conversation root's stable `[data-phase]` attribute with doubled specificity, so the override keeps working after the conversation package updates (hashed class names change).
- The host half (`lib/index.js`) is a no-op placeholder so the loader entry mounts.
